description: Generated from authored prediction calls and independent KP1-H expectations; do not edit.

cases.title: R, differing offsets: NOAA's event method
A, differing offsets
an absent time offset is 0, an absent height offset the identity
shifted events that swap order are ordered by time; a reference high 178 min before start (inside the padding M = 250 + 60 min) lands inside the window
cases.note: step 1: the reference high at 05:01:52 shifts +250 min to 09:11:52; a padding of 120 min (or none) loses it

cases.title: +12.5 and -7.25 min give whole-second times, floor(t + 0.5); +12.345 and -7.29 min (740.7 s, -437.4 s) are added to the unrounded r, then rounded once
heights at a station with differing offsets: extremes_only
the reference's noaa set has no chart datum: datum_unavailable
a subordinate current station: events by offsets (a reference slack 5 min 20 s before start lands inside the window); currents is extremes_only
cases.note: step 1: the reference slack_before_flood at 08:54:40 shifts +5.5 min to 09:00:10

cases.title: a null adjustment or ratio drops that event type (omitted_event_types)
the event path on a reference whose chart datum is 0.85 above its zero, with the subordinate's own datum: chart (the default), mhhw and msl
equal offsets, R 0.9, +37 min: heights by folding, method folded_offsets
equal offsets, A +0.15 m, -12 min
the folded station's extremes, equal to the event method's away from New Year (times within 1 s, heights within 1e-5 m: the step's compare)
a window across 2013-01-01 with +40 min: the folded curve uses year Y(t)'s tables
differing offsets: heights fails with extremes_only (the offsets differ); extremes works
R ratio 0 and -0.5, equal and differing offsets: heights and extremes are invalid_argument
height_adjusted_type X (read as other): invalid_argument naming X, equal and differing offsets; with a failing reference too, still invalid_argument (the type check comes first)
cases.note: OTC-P-0049's reference has no noaa set (reference_unavailable without the X)

cases.title: differing offsets and an R ratio of 0: heights is invalid_argument, not extremes_only

the reference is active, but its only noaa water-level set is no_constants (its gesla-fit set does not count): heights, heights_at and extremes are reference_unavailable, at an equal-offsets and a differing-offsets station (the reference checks come before extremes_only)
a current_offsets reference that is active with no usable current set: current_events is reference_unavailable
a current_offsets reference that is not in the release (it loads: current_offsets are raw in 1.0): current_events is reference_unavailable
a current_offsets reference that is a removed station (a tombstone; it loads): current_events is reference_unavailable
